mainEntity.name: What is Itemba Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Itemba Group is a Tanzanian multi-industry holding group headquartered in Mpemba-Tunduma, Songwe Region.

mainEntity.name: Which companies are part of Itemba Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The group includes Mwanjalisi Oil Co Ltd, Westsides Company Ltd, and Itemba Enterprises Co Ltd.

mainEntity.name: Which sectors does Itemba Group operate in?

acceptedAnswer.text: The group operates across energy, trade, logistics, construction supplies, hospitality, parking, real estate, and manufacturing-related activities.

mainEntity.name: How can business enquiries be submitted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Business enquiries can be submitted by phone, WhatsApp, or email through the contact details listed on the website.

mainEntity.name: What products does Mwanjalisi Oil supply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mwanjalisi Oil manages ITEMBA-branded filling stations supplying diesel, petrol, kerosene, and lubricants, and also manages UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD for motorists, transport operators, and corridor logistics customers.

mainEntity.name: Where is Mwanjalisi Oil located?

acceptedAnswer.text: The company operates from Songwe Region. Its current public-facing station brands include ITEMBA-MPEMBA near the Tunduma Bus Station and ITEMBA-UZUNGUNI in Uzunguni Area, Mpemba, with UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD also located in Uzunguni Area, Mpemba-Tunduma.

mainEntity.name: Can business fuel enquiries be submitted online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Business customers can contact Itemba Group by phone, WhatsApp, or email and the enquiry will be routed to the relevant Mwanjalisi Oil team.

mainEntity.name: What does Westsides Company distribute?

acceptedAnswer.text: Westsides Company handles wholesale beverages and manages ITEMBA-HARDWARE for building materials, tools, construction equipment, and related supplies.

mainEntity.name: Who does Westsides Company serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The company serves more than 50 beverage stockists across Songwe Region, bars and night clubs in urban centres, international bulk buyers, contractors, construction companies, lodging and restaurant customers, and regional trade customers.

mainEntity.name: How should supplier or bulk purchase enquiries be sent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supplier and bulk purchase enquiries can be sent through the group phone, WhatsApp, or email channels listed on the contact page.

mainEntity.name: What are the Itemba Enterprises divisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Itemba Enterprises focuses on Itemba Logistics, cross-border transit, and emerging business opportunities.

mainEntity.name: Does Itemba Enterprises handle cross-border logistics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Logistics is the flagship activity and focuses on local goods movement from Dar es Salaam to the Southern Highlands, plus cross-border transit to and from Zambia, DRC, Zimbabwe, and Malawi through the Tunduma corridor.

mainEntity.name: Can one enquiry cover multiple divisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send the enquiry through the group contact channels and it can be routed to the relevant operating division or divisions.

mainEntity.name: Which fuel products are available through Itemba Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: ITEMBA-MPEMBA and ITEMBA-UZUNGUNI, managed by Mwanjalisi Oil, handle diesel, petrol, kerosene, and lubricants for retail customers and business enquiries. Mwanjalisi Oil also manages UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD for corridor parking and vehicle staging.

mainEntity.name: Can transport operators submit fuel or parking enquiries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Transport operators can contact the group office by phone, WhatsApp, or email and fuel or UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD enquiries will be routed to Mwanjalisi Oil.

mainEntity.name: What products does Westsides Company distribute?

acceptedAnswer.text: Westsides Company distributes beverages in wholesale and manages ITEMBA-HARDWARE for building materials, tools, construction equipment, and related supply categories.

mainEntity.name: Who are the main Westsides target customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main target customers include more than 50 stockists across Songwe Region, bars and night clubs in urban centres such as Tunduma, Mlowo, and Vwawa, international bulk buyers using the Tunduma border, and construction companies serving the real estate and infrastructure market.

mainEntity.name: Can bulk purchase enquiries be sent online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bulk purchase and supplier enquiries can be submitted through the contact page, WhatsApp, or email.

mainEntity.name: Does Itemba Group handle cross-border logistics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Itemba Enterprises handles logistics-related enquiries focused on local distribution from Dar es Salaam into the Southern Highlands and cross-border transit through the Tunduma corridor.

mainEntity.name: Which logistics routes are most relevant?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key local route is Dar es Salaam to Southern Highlands regions including Songwe, Mbeya, Rukwa, Ruvuma, and Iringa. The growing transit market connects to and from Zambia, DRC, Zimbabwe, and Malawi.

mainEntity.name: Where are the logistics operations based?

acceptedAnswer.text: The group is headquartered in Mpemba-Tunduma, Songwe Region, close to the Tanzania-Zambia border corridor.

mainEntity.name: Which construction goods are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: ITEMBA-HARDWARE handles Nondo, roofing sheets, wire nails, paints, square pipes, round pipes, H-beams, I-beams, U-channels, and related construction supplies.

mainEntity.name: Which company handles hardware enquiries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardware and construction supply enquiries are handled through ITEMBA-HARDWARE under Westsides Company Ltd.

mainEntity.name: Which Itemba Group division handles hospitality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hospitality, lodging, restaurant, and bar services are handled through UZUNGUNI INN under Westsides Company Ltd.

mainEntity.name: How can hospitality enquiries be made?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hospitality enquiries can be sent through the group contact channels and routed to the relevant division.

mainEntity.name: Which division handles real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Real estate and property-related services are handled through Itemba Estate under Itemba Enterprises.

mainEntity.name: Can property enquiries be submitted through the website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Property enquiries can be sent through the group contact channels and routed to Itemba Estate.

mainEntity.name: Where is Itemba Group located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Itemba Group is headquartered at Itemba Filling Station along the Tunduma-Ileje Highway in Mpemba, Tunduma, Songwe Region, Tanzania.

mainEntity.name: Why is Tunduma important for Itemba Group operations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tunduma is a strategic border corridor area that supports regional trade, transport movement, logistics, and customer access for the group companies.

mainEntity.name: Which services are available from the Songwe-Tunduma location?

acceptedAnswer.text: The group supports enquiries across fuel, trade distribution, logistics, construction supplies, hospitality, real estate, and related services.
